subtitle: Math and Science for Environmental Engineering
courseType:
Mathematics and Science Program
Mathematics and Science Courses
educationalGoal: Students will (1) acquire the necessary mathematical knowledge of functions, calculus, and statistics for structural, soil, and fluid mechanics, materials, surveying, and environmental engineering. (2) understand the importance of fundamental mathematics for solving problems in civil engineering. (3) apply mathematical knowledge to various problems.
advice: This is a course on the fundamental mathematics used in structural mechanics, soil mechanics, fluid mechanics, materials technology, surveying, and environmental engineering. Students will apply the learned mathematics to analyze various phenomena related to environmental civil engineering. Students are expected to (1) deepen their mathematical understanding of exponential, logarithmic, and trigonometric functions, and tackle real problems requiring the application of this knowledge. (2) deepen their mathematical understanding of differentiation and integration, and tackle real problems requiring the application of this knowledge. (3) understand basic operations and graph drawings and data analysis by using Excel. (4) learn statistical data processing methods and analyze data generated in experiments. (5) utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center and the teachers of the environmental civil engineering. This course should make it possible for students to apply their knowledge of fundamental mathematics to solve environmental civil engineering problems.
books: Textbook: "Math and Science for Environmental Engineering", KIT
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of mathematics learned in Mathematics and Science for Engineer I, II.

activityGoals.body: Ability to apply knowledge of fundamental functions to environmental problems.
Ability to apply knowledge of calculus to environmental problems.
Ability to make graphs of fundamental functions and data analysis using Excel.
Ability to analyze environmental experimental data and understand statistical processing.
Ability to understand the meanings of fundamental English words for mathematics and environmental engineering.
Ability to understand the contents of the class, complete all reports, attend every class, etc.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the mathematical meanings of exponential functions, logarithmic functions, trigonometric functions, differentiation and integration, and statistics used in class. achievementLevels.standard: (1) Tackle problems related to exponential functions, logarithmic functions, trigonometric functions, differentiation and integration, and statistics. (2) Tackle environmental problems using mathematical knowledge.
